verdict.rationale: First-party platform docs describe a public API surface for Skills. A dedicated Skills API lets you upload and manage custom skills, and the Messages API `container` parameter takes a `skill_id`, `type` and optional `version`, with up to 20 skills per request. The Claude Agent SDK adds programmatic control over which skills a session can invoke. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the Skills API endpoints beyond a link to the create operation (e.g. list/update/delete and versioning), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving skills through the API.
